sentences.text: Hmph. The notion of a haunting is unsupported by the data I have analyzed, which shows a clear energy anomaly in the house.
Specifically, between 05:40 and 05:50, the appliance energy observed was 340 Wh.
This usage is significantly higher than the expected 57 Wh and falls well outside the expected range of 44 Wh to 88 Wh.
This spike, which the system labels as "the machines waking up", probably indicates a routine appliance cycle starting early in the morning.
